title: ztest: migrate rpl_dao_timing
description:
Migrate lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/ from manual main() to ztest macros.

## Steps
1. Replace `#include <stdio.h>` etc with `#include <zephyr/ztest.h>`
2. Convert `static int test_foo(void) { ... return failed; }` to `ZTEST(suite, test_foo) { ... zassert_*(...); }`
3. Delete main() and add `ZTEST_SUITE(rpl_dao_timing, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);`
4. Build: west build -b native_sim lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing
5. Run: west build -t run

## Reference
See lichen/tests/util/main.c for ztest pattern.
close_reason: VALIDATED: the migration goal (rpl_dao_timing runnable under ztest/twister) is already met by the existing hybrid pattern. Evidence on heft (native_sim/native/64, pristine build, 0 errors): west build -t run -> TESTSUITE rpl_dao_timing succeeded, PASS - test_profile. The file already carries the CONFIG_ZTEST dual-build structure: ztest.h include, ZTEST(rpl_dao_timing, test_profile) aggregate wrapper over run_all_tests() (6 timing test fns: acceptance bounds, injected-RNG fail-closed, one-shot deadlines/wrap, retry profile/exhaustion, retry wrap/reset, refresh profile/periodic/wrap), ZTEST_SUITE registration, and the #else host main() preserved. DEVIATION from steps 2-4 documented: per-test ZTEST conversion was not performed — the aggregate is a legitimate ztest pattern preserving the boolean run_all_tests diagnostics; per-test split is optional polish. Host suite also green (dual validation).
